key_finding:
The supplementary figure (Cross_Validation_T54_vs_Drobczyk_2026-08-13.png) visually shows the convergence of T54 and Drobczyk's benchmark in three panels:

(a) Both give sigma/m ~ 1 cm^2/g at m_phi ~ 3-15 MeV
(b) Both invisible to direct detection (sigma_SI << neutrino floor)
(c) Both reach Omega h^2 = 0.12 with different coupling mechanisms

This figure is recommended for the supplementary material.
